name: Reska: Tales of the Blue Mist Flower
source:
The Blue Mist Flower is a rare flower that can only be found near the cove. It's said that if a person should find said flower and hold it up to a full moon, they can make a single wish that will come true no matter what.

Kasey always found the story fascinating and secretly, deep in her heart, she believes it to be true but is too scared to go to the cove on her own.

When not inside her own little world, Kasey is in a reality that's lonely. Having no friends and living alone (kind of), she spends most of her time either reading or playing video games.

Luckily for her, a girl name Sena sees past her odd nature and anti-social ways, and takes interest in her. It's here that Kasey and Sena develop a close friendship. Now with someone beside her, Kasey begins to form new friendships in school and for once feels happy.

As she does however, she worries that the happy time won't last forever and so she decides to see if the story is true, and makes a wish with the Blue Mist Flower. If the tale turns out to be real, will her wish be a blessing or curse?

[Edited from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1766810169/reska-a-yuri-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter Campaign Page[/url]]
translation:
蓝雾花是一种稀有花朵，只能在海湾附近找到。据说如果有人发现这种花，在满月下举起它，就能许下一个无论如何都会实现的愿望。

凯茜一直觉得这个故事很迷人，内心深处也秘密相信它是真的，却害怕独自前往海湾。

离开自己的小世界时，凯茜面对的是孤独的现实。她没有朋友，独自生活（某种意义上），大多数时间都在读书或玩电子游戏。

幸运的是，一个名叫塞娜的女孩看穿了她古怪、反社交的一面，并对她产生兴趣。凯茜和塞娜由此建立了亲密友谊。有了陪伴后，凯茜开始在学校结交新朋友，第一次感到幸福。

然而，她担心快乐时光不会永远持续，于是决定验证故事真假，用蓝雾花许愿。如果传说是真的，她的愿望会成为祝福还是诅咒？
